row.team_price_text: Standard: $16.17/mo billed yearly ($18 monthly), 1 seat, up to 3 with add-on
row.evidence: Brevo's pricing page and help centre offer SAML SSO (a $324/month add-on on Professional, included on Enterprise) but no SCIM: the help-centre search for 'scim' returns 0 articles and the SSO guide requires each user to be added to Brevo before signing in.
row.notes: Status changed from gated (June) to none. June's 'SCIM only on Enterprise' has no first-party source: SCIM is absent from the pricing page, the help centre (search 'scim' = 0 results), the SSO guide and the developer docs index (developers.brevo.com/llms.txt). SSO users must already exist in Brevo (no JIT). Prices: Starter $8.08/mo yearly (single user), Standard $16.17/mo yearly (1 seat, up to 3 with $12/mo add-on), Professional $449.08/mo yearly (10 seats; SAML SSO add-on $324/mo, confirmed), Enterprise now 'Starting from $2,499 per month' (June: Contact Sales ~$10,000/yr+, unsourced). Priced by email volume and contacts plus seat bundles, so per-user fields are null. June team plan Starter is single-user only, so team plan is now Standard. Name updated from 'Sendinblue / Brevo' to Brevo.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 marketing seat; REST API available but only one user.

plans.name: Standard
plans.price_text: $16.17/month yearly ($18 monthly); 1 seat, up to 3 with add-on

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SSO & SAML included; unlimited seats; user activity logs API.

scim.notes: Not offered by absence; see searched.

capabilities.notes: Users are invited (not created); revoke removes access; permissions updated per feature. Plan inferred: invitations fail on an 'unsupported plan' or at the seat limit, and multi-user starts at Standard.

rate_limits.text: Three tiers: general (all plans), advanced (Professional and Enterprise), extended (Enterprise).

limitations.text: Invitations fail on an unsupported plan or when the seat limit is reached.

okta.notes: Brevo's guide sets up a custom internal SAML app ('I'm an Okta customer adding an internal app'); okta.com/integrations/brevo/ and /sendinblue/ returned 404.

entra.notes: Brevo's guide creates a new enterprise application (not a gallery app); gallery listing not confirmed.
